## Primer workflow de prueba (Fase 2)

Antes de ejecutar: abre el nodo **Company Brain** (o **Servicios**) y crea la credencial Postgres con estos valores (son los mismos de tu archivo .env local):

- Host: `postgres`
- Database: `ai_marketing_agent`
- User: `n8n_app`
- Password: el valor de `DB_POSTGRESDB_PASSWORD` en tu `.env`
- Port: `5432`
- SSL: `disable`

Luego pulsa **Ejecutar workflow** y revisa la salida de cada nodo Postgres.

SELECT c.id AS company_id, c.name, c.timezone, c.default_currency, b.sector, b.city, b.phone, b.email, b.tone, b.colors_primary, b.colors_secondary
FROM companies c
LEFT JOIN company_brand b ON b.company_id = c.id
ORDER BY c.id;

SELECT company_id, name, description, price, currency, duration
FROM company_services
WHERE active = true
ORDER BY company_id, name;
